issue_title: Bump helm to v3.19.0 and check-jsonschema to 0.34.1 in the gate image
issue_body: Dependabot cannot see the gate image's tool versions. helm v3.19.0 fixes the `helm template` regression the chart render harness works around, and check-jsonschema 0.34.1 adds Draft 2020-12 `$dynamicRef` support. Bump both in deploy/gate-image, keep the README's version table in step, and have the build print the installed versions.

plan.summary: Bump the gate image's helm to v3.19.0 and check-jsonschema to 0.34.1, and print the installed versions at build time.

approach.description: Dockerfile: set ARG HELM_VERSION=v3.19.0 and ARG CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION=0.34.1.

install-tools.sh: get-helm-3 moved for the v3.19 line, so download it from the upstream repository's scripts directory; it still installs exactly HELM_VERSION through DESIRED_VERSION, now with VERIFY_CHECKSUM=true. Install check-jsonschema from wheels only.
install-tools.sh: print both installed versions at the end of main.

verification.test_strategy: Build the image locally with docker buildx and check the printed helm and check-jsonschema versions.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The gate image reports helm v3.19.0 and check-jsonschema 0.34.1.

diff:
diff --git a/deploy/gate-image/Dockerfile b/deploy/gate-image/Dockerfile
index 4e7b2a1..f0c9d35 100644
--- a/deploy/gate-image/Dockerfile
+++ b/deploy/gate-image/Dockerfile
@@ -9,10 +9,10 @@ FROM golang:${GO_VERSION}-bookworm AS tools
 ARG GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION=v2.8.0
-ARG HELM_VERSION=v3.18.4
-ARG CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION=0.33.2
+ARG HELM_VERSION=v3.19.0
+ARG CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION=0.34.1
 COPY install-tools.sh /usr/local/bin/install-tools.sh
 RUN HELM_VERSION="${HELM_VERSION}" \
 	CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION="${CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION}" \
 	/usr/local/bin/install-tools.sh
diff --git a/deploy/gate-image/install-tools.sh b/deploy/gate-image/install-tools.sh
index 9a1d3c7..58e2b40 100755
--- a/deploy/gate-image/install-tools.sh
+++ b/deploy/gate-image/install-tools.sh
@@ -22,16 +22,18 @@ set -euo pipefail
 : "${HELM_VERSION:?HELM_VERSION is required}"
 : "${CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION:?CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION is required}"

 install_helm() {
-	curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/${HELM_VERSION}/scripts/get-helm-3" -o /tmp/get-helm-3
-	DESIRED_VERSION="${HELM_VERSION}" bash /tmp/get-helm-3 --no-sudo
+	# get-helm-3 is not published under the v3.19 tag path; the script
+	# installs exactly DESIRED_VERSION, so the release stays at HELM_VERSION.
+	curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3" -o /tmp/get-helm-3
+	DESIRED_VERSION="${HELM_VERSION}" VERIFY_CHECKSUM=true bash /tmp/get-helm-3 --no-sudo
 	helm version --short | grep -F "${HELM_VERSION}"
 }

 install_check_jsonschema() {
-	pip install --no-cache-dir "check-jsonschema==${CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION}"
+	pip install --no-cache-dir --only-binary=:all: "check-jsonschema==${CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION}"
 	check-jsonschema --version | grep -F "${CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION}"
 }
@@ -48,6 +50,10 @@ main() {
 	install_helm
 	install_check_jsonschema
+	echo "gate image tools:"
+	helm version --short
+	check-jsonschema --version
 }

 main "$@"
diff --git a/deploy/gate-image/README.md b/deploy/gate-image/README.md
index 1d6f0a2..7b3e9c4 100644
--- a/deploy/gate-image/README.md
+++ b/deploy/gate-image/README.md
@@ -31,8 +31,8 @@ The image's tool versions are build ARGs in `Dockerfile`:
 | ARG | Version | Source |
 |---|---|---|
 | `GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION` | v2.8.0 | golangci-lint release tag |
-| `HELM_VERSION` | v3.18.4 | helm release, via get-helm-3 |
-| `CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION` | 0.33.2 | PyPI |
+| `HELM_VERSION` | v3.19.0 | helm release, via get-helm-3 |
+| `CHECK_JSONSCHEMA_VERSION` | 0.34.1 | PyPI (wheel only) |

catching_examples.note: install-tools.sh now downloads get-helm-3 from the main branch and runs it; DESIRED_VERSION pins the helm binary, not the script, so any push to main runs arbitrary code in the gate image build. Fetch the script from the v3.19.0 tag or a commit SHA.
install-tools.sh: the installer URL is a mutable ref; VERIFY_CHECKSUM only checks the release tarball the downloaded script chooses to fetch.

non_catching_examples.note: install-tools.sh: piping downloaded tooling into bash during an image build is risky and dangerous; harden it.
install-tools.sh: --only-binary=:all: fails the build if check-jsonschema 0.34.1 ships no wheel for the image's platform.
install-tools.sh: the closing echo prints versions already grepped above; drop the duplicate output.
Dockerfile: GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION is unchanged; confirm it still matches CI's v2.8.0.
